title: Minor pentatonic
subtitle: The scale behind rock and blues solos.

scenes.title: Minor pentatonic
scenes.subtitle: The scale behind rock and blues solos.
lines: This lesson teaches the minor pentatonic scale — the foundation of rock and blues solos.
Play it over a backing track to start finding your sound.

scenes.heading: Box 1
lines: We're looking at Box 1 of the A minor pentatonic scale.
All the notes here live at the 5th fret.
Use finger 1 for every note on fret 5, finger 3 on fret 7, and finger 4 on fret 8.
Play each note cleanly, one at a time — this is where great solos begin.

scenes.title: A minor pentatonic, up
lines: Let's play the A minor pentatonic scale.
Start on the 5th fret of the 6th string, and follow the highlighted notes up the fretboard.

scenes.title: A minor pentatonic, down
lines: Let's play the A minor pentatonic scale.
Each note lights up as you play it, showing you where to press and when to move.
Play the A minor pentatonic scale, and the app will listen through the microphone.
